read.title: FBA Stock Check Before Black Friday
read.text:
Team,

Our weekly inventory check shows that we are running low on two products: the vitamin C serum (about 12 days of stock) and the sleeping mask (about 9 days). To avoid a stockout, please replenish both items this week so they reach the warehouse in time for Black Friday.

On the other hand, we still have too many units of the summer sunscreen. Please create a removal order for half of them to reduce storage fees.

Thanks,
Minsu

write.task: FBA 재고를 점검했더니 인기 상품 하나가 곧 품절될 것 같아요. 팀에 상황을 알리고 재입고를 요청하는 짧은 메시지를 써 보세요.
write.en: Write a short message telling your team a popular item is running low and asking them to restock it.
write.model:
Hi team,

We are running low on the cica cream. We only have about ten days of stock left at FBA. Could we replenish it this week so it arrives in time for the holiday sale? A stockout now would hurt our ranking.

Thanks,
Minsu
